AI Resume Analyzer

Turn a job description into actionable feedback.

A document-analysis application comparing resumes with job descriptions and generating structured improvement suggestions.

FlaskOpenRouterPythonPyPDF2python-docx
View source on GitHub ↗

01 / THE PROBLEM

Why build it?

Job seekers need to understand where a resume matches a role and where relevant information is missing or unclear.

02 / THE IMPLEMENTATION

How it fits together.

The reviewed repository documents PDF and DOCX input, AI-assisted comparison, recommendations, and document export. Its implementation uses Flask, OpenRouter, and Python document-processing libraries.

  • Resume and job-description comparison
  • Missing-skill and improvement suggestions
  • PDF and DOCX document workflows
Project context

Document-analysis prototype for job seekers. Resume feedback is advisory and should be reviewed by the user.
